title: Zebra holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M68 30 Q66 40 62 48 Q60 52 58 55' fill='none' stroke='#cfd8e3' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='22' rx='10' ry='12' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='18' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ff96a8'/>
  <path d='M68 34 l-2 3 h4 z' fill='#c72c4a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='68' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#e8edf5'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='31' y='80' width='6' height='13' rx='2' fill='#c9d2e0'/>
  <rect x='53' y='80' width='6' height='13' rx='2' fill='#c9d2e0'/>
  <rect x='31' y='80' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <rect x='53' y='80' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d='M33 60 q4 6 2 12' fill='none' stroke='#3a3f6b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 55 q2 8 0 16' fill='none' stroke='#3a3f6b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M51 57 q-1 7 1 14' fill='none' stroke='#3a3f6b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- raised arm holding string -->
  <path d='M56 56 Q62 50 59 54' fill='none' stroke='#c9d2e0' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='42' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#e8edf5'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='30' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#c9d2e0' transform='rotate(-20 36 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='30' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#c9d2e0' transform='rotate(20 52 30)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='50' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#cfd8e3'/>
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='49' rx='1.3' ry='1.6' fill='#5a4a6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='49' rx='1.3' ry='1.6' fill='#5a4a6b'/>
  <!-- head stripes -->
  <path d='M36 36 q5 3 4 8' fill='none' stroke='#3a3f6b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 36 q-5 3 -4 8' fill='none' stroke='#3a3f6b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 34 v5' fill='none' stroke='#3a3f6b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='38' r='2' fill='#2a2d4a'/>
  <circle cx='48.7' cy='37.3' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M64 66 q6 2 4 8' fill='none' stroke='#3a3f6b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
